Commentary.Commentary: That is all from this game. History has been rewritten. United Arab Emirates have shown the cricketing world, they are ready to showcase their talent on the big stage. Mind you, Bangladesh were playing an experienced team, so they were the favourites to win the series but UAE had more hunger on the given day. Muhammad Waseem has been handed over the trophy. His teammates join now as the team poses for the cameras. That is all from this game. Hope you enjoyed the coverage. It's goodbye from our side!

Litton Das, the skipper of Bangladesh says the performance was not up to the mark. Credits United Arab Emirates for the way they played. Reckons they bowled second in all three games and dew was a big factor. Mentions Parvez Hossain Emon and a couple of players did well but overall have to work more to win.

Muhammad Waseem WINS THE PLAYER OF THE SERIES AWARD. The skipper of United Arab Emirates congratulates the staff and management for the historic night. Tells this series means a lot, collectively they did a commendable job. Reckons Haider Ali bowled well on his debut.

Alishan Sharafu wins the PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD. He says the plan was simple to play as many balls as possible. Tells losing Muhammad Waseem early was a big blow but that gave opportunity for the other batters to do the job. Mentions Asif Khan asked to keep the scoreboard ticking. Reckons everyone is pumped up and were optimistic to win the series.
...Presentation...

During the chase, the onus was once again on the captain, Muhammad Waseem to do the bulk of the job but Shoriful Islam came up with a peach of a delivery to get rid of him. Muhammad Zohaib too failed to make an impact but the task was handed over to the ever-reliable middle order consisting of Rahul Chopra, Asif Khan and Alishan Sharafu who have done a brilliant job throughout the series to pile up runs. Today, Alishan Sharafu and Asif Khan put their hands up to chase it down. A big, big victory for the UAE!

A complete team performance from UAE! They chose to bowl first and pushed Bangladesh on the back foot right away. Bangladesh were reeling at 84/8 in the 14th over, done and out but thanks to Jaker Ali's fighting knock of 41 along with the tail, Hasan Mahmud and Shoriful Islam helped Bangladesh reach a respectable total. Bangladesh had the momentum, however it was United Arab Emirates who went into the break with a big smile on their face, knowing the bowlers have done a commendable job to give them a chance to create history.

United Arab Emirates have scripted history! They have beaten Bangladesh for the first time in the T20Is! The associate team came back from behind to win the series 2-1 against a giant and experienced Bangladesh team. It was a historic day for the United Arab Emirates and their fans.
